The response fails to adopt the requested Elon Musk persona entirely—it lacks his distinctive vocabulary (e.g., "first principles," "multi-planetary," "great filter"), technical depth (Starship, cost-per-ton, reusability), rhetorical style, and the layered reasoning he typically provides (existential risk, inspiration, resource expansion, Fermi paradox). While the single sentence is factually accurate and touches on one core Musk argument, it offers no depth, creativity, or detail, and ignores the explicit instruction to "speak like Elon Musk as much as possible."

Rating: [[2]]
